rules.rationale: This is the negative-input branch of the piecewise fizzEnd summary, defining the final loop index as zero when the outer loop does not run.
This is the nonnegative-input branch of the piecewise fizzEnd summary, defining the final loop index as N.
This is the base equation for digitSevens, defining the decimal-seven count as zero once the nonnegative digit scan is exhausted.
This recurrence defines digitSevens for a positive integer whose last decimal digit is seven by adding one and recursing on the quotient by ten.
This recurrence defines digitSevens for a positive integer whose last decimal digit is not seven by recursing on the quotient by ten without incrementing.
This equation defines fizzContribution as digitSevens when the current integer is divisible by 11.
This equation defines fizzContribution as digitSevens for the remaining eligible case: not divisible by 11 but divisible by 13.
This equation completes the fizzContribution definition by assigning zero when the integer is divisible by neither 11 nor 13.
This is the base equation for the interval summary fizzFrom, defining an empty interval's contribution as zero.
This recurrence defines fizzFrom over a nonempty interval as the current fizzContribution plus the summary of the remaining interval.

This simplification rule supplies integer-addition associativity to normalize symbolic invariant sums; it is an additional algebraic fact, not a summary definition, and prove.sh compiles it into the definition before proving any claims.
This macro equation defines the named INNER-LOOP proof term by expanding it to the exact translated while-loop AST used in the program.
This macro equation defines the named OUTER-LOOP proof term by expanding it to the exact translated outer while-loop AST, including the INNER-LOOP macro.
